_comment: Exp 40 plan-D Unit A (admissibility parser) RE-RUN under the HARDENED convergence gate (2026-05-18, founder-directed). Unit A's prior plan-F runs (exp40_slice_admissibility_20260516T223952Z and earlier) were UN-HARDENED: the legacy gamma-alt OR gate, live-at-round accounting, bare 0.7 critical cut. The full-budget resume was FALSIFIED (commit f1a5127: gamma crossed 0.30 on a single round by 0.0047, not reproducible from the settled registry 0.231, re-seeded pristine). This config re-runs the SAME slice under the hardened gate so Unit A's verdict is on the same frozen, hostile-reviewer-reproducible footing as Units B and C. hardened_gate_enabled=true routes through _check_hardened_convergence (F4 settled-registry + F6 consequence-based critical definition + conjunction + dual-series + sparsity fallback). _convergence_criteria.description: HARDENED gate (hardened_gate_enabled=true). Converged iff, on the SETTLED post-reconciliation registry critical/structural series: (A) gamma_critical >= 0.30 AND (B) sustained over 2 consecutive settled recomputes AND leave-one-round-out robust within 0.05, AND (C) 3 consecutive settled rounds with zero novel critical findings. Sparsity fallback: if cumulative critical < 8 closure rests on (C) alone, gamma_critical reported-not-gated. All-severity gamma is logged as a diagnostic only and NEVER gates. Conjunction, not the legacy OR. Supersedes the un-hardened plan-F verdict for this slice.
_convergence_criteria.pass_condition: (gamma_crit>=0.30 sustained+loo-robust AND 3r zero-novel-critical) OR (sparsity fallback: cum_crit<8 AND 3r zero-novel-critical).
_convergence_criteria.fail_condition: Any model fails to produce parseable output in 2+ consecutive rounds.
